intents.intro: Look inside what the device understands. Try a sentence to see which intent it would match, see which skills are active for a follow-up, and browse every registered intent. Nothing here speaks to you or runs a skill — it only inspects.
intents.unavailable: The intent service did not answer. Is the device running?
intents.dry.title: Try a sentence
intents.dry.desc: Type a sentence the way you would say it. The device reports the intent it would match, without answering or running the skill.
intents.active.title: Active skills
intents.active.desc: The skills that can handle what you say next, most recent first. A skill here can answer a follow-up without the wake word.
intents.active.none: No skills are active right now.
intents.list.title: All intents
intents.list.desc: Every intent registered on the device, with its skill, language and how it is matched. Filter by a skill id, and open one to see its full definition.
